what: Readings taken over the cable from a Meta Quest 3S while its wearer went through Setpiece as a newcomer on the live site (setpiece.jonathansolvesproblems.com), on 16 November 2026. The sets were built by the set designer during the session from sentences the wearer spoke; nothing was replayed. Frame rates are frames counted over three or nine seconds of the session's own animation loop. Times are from the session's log (one line each time its state changed).
device: Meta Quest 3S, Quest Browser, both hands tracked

found: A newcomer had a frame of their own shot on the board 53 and 68 seconds after Enter XR.
Inside a full-size set the designer had just built, the session held 86 to 89 frames a second.

The designer wrote one castle bigger than the stage (6.9 m across, 6.2 m high) and it stood into the panel: made pieces are now held to 5 by 3 by 4 metres. The next two castles stood inside the stage.

Walking by a ring on the floor did not work for a seated wearer: with eyes 0.9 m above the floor a slight downward look put the ring 6 to 12 m away. It was replaced the same evening by pulling the set by hand (which on 17 Nov gave the wearer a headache, and was replaced in turn by pointing at the floor with a beam and pinching, in the emulator only so far), which has run in the emulator only.
